julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant cyan (#00E5FF) to fit the grounded optimism of the technofuturistic setting, offering a stark contrast against the black to represent the neon-lit atmosphere.
storyPanel: In the hum of the neon-lit transit hub, Elara works as a sensory calibrator, helping both newly-awakened AIs and augmented humans tune out the overwhelming static of the city. While her own optical hardware is outdated, the quiet empathy in her gaze makes her an anchor for those struggling to find their balance in a hyper-connected world.
